Kalye — Mobile Banking App

A friendly mobile bank for first-time savers: balances, transfers and savings goals without jargon.

Type
Concept Project

UI/UX Design

Proposed tools
Mobile UI design · Information architecture · Accessibility review
THE PROBLEM

Why it matters

Banking apps often feel intimidating to young or first-time users, with dense menus and unclear fees.

DESIGN APPROACH

Approach

Large balance, three primary actions, and plain-language labels. Goals use progress rings so saving feels visible.

Key features

  • 01Card and balance overview
  • 02One-tap send and request
  • 03Savings goals with progress
  • 04Readable transaction history
